name: Stompers
description: The Glory Stompers were a Brooklyn street gang active from at least the early 1960s through the early 1970s, with documented presence in the Bushwick neighborhood (Knickerbocker and Halsey area) by 1960–1962 and in Coney Island in the early 1970s. They were contemporaries of gangs such as the Savage Skulls, Black Spades, Blue Diamonds, and Black Cats.

sources.title: Marcy, Sumner and a Nest of Youth Gangs | New York City Fighting Gangs
